name: Playwright
description: Cross-browser automation with reliable locators, tracing, and test runner.
why: The most dependable base for agent browser testing and scraping.

name: Puppeteer
why: Useful when the target is Chromium-only and the API fits better.

name: Scrapy
description: Python framework for large-scale structured crawling.
why: A mature choice for crawlers that need queues, retries, and pipelines.

name: Apify
description: Hosted scraping and automation platform with ready-made actors.
why: Avoids maintaining browser infrastructure for common targets.

name: Browserbase
description: Hosted headless browser infrastructure for agents.
why: Scales browser sessions without local Chrome management.

name: Stagehand
description: AI-native browser automation with a Playwright-compatible core.
why: A middle ground between brittle selectors and fully autonomous browsing.

name: Steel Browser
why: Self-hostable browser sessions with a clean API.

name: Trigger.dev
description: Background jobs and durable workflows for TypeScript.
why: Good fit for long-running scrapes, agent tasks, and retries.

name: Inngest
description: Event-driven durable functions with steps and retries.
why: Makes agent and automation workflows observable and resumable.

name: Temporal
description: Durable execution platform for long-running workflows.
why: The heavyweight option when workflow state must survive failures.
